message.content:
Desserts are a rainbow of colors—there’s no single “color of the dessert.”  
It all depends on what’s in it:

| Dessert | Typical Color(s) | Why |
|---------|------------------|-----|
| Chocolate cake | Deep brown | Cocoa powder or melted chocolate |
| Vanilla cake | White or off‑white | Milk, eggs, and vanilla |
| Strawberry shortcake | Pink | Fresh strawberries |
| Lemon meringue pie | Yellow (lemon) + white (meringue) | Lemon curd and whipped egg whites |
| Fruit tart | Multicolored | Assorted fresh fruit |
| Ice cream | Varies (pink, brown, white, etc.) | Flavors and mix‑ins |
| Macarons | Pastel hues (pink, mint, lavender, etc.) | Food coloring |

If you were actually asking about a **desert** (the arid landscape), the typical color is a sandy beige or light tan, sometimes with orange or reddish undertones depending on the soil and vegetation.

So, the “color of the dessert” is whatever color the particular sweet treats happen to be!
